sources.title: ISO 21448:2022 Road vehicles — Safety of the intended functionality
sources.notes: Published SOTIF reference. Covers functional/performance insufficiency and reasonably foreseeable misuse; excludes conventional ISO 26262 faults and cybersecurity threats.

sources.title: ISO/WD 21448 Edition 2
sources.notes: Under development in 2026 and intended to replace ISO 21448:2022 when published. Not used as a conformity baseline.

sources.title: ISO 26262 Road vehicles — Functional safety
sources.notes: Used to keep conventional fault handling and safety lifecycle distinct from SOTIF insufficiency analysis.

sources.title: ISO/PAS 8800:2024 Road vehicles — Safety and artificial intelligence
sources.notes: Public ISO abstract confirms scope for safety-related road-vehicle E/E systems using AI and risks from AI output insufficiencies, systematic errors and random hardware errors. KINGMAST uses it only as a complementary research reference for ML perception/monitoring; no ISO/PAS 8800 conformity claim is made.

sources.title: ISO 34502:2022 Road vehicles — Test scenarios for automated driving systems — Scenario based safety evaluation framework
sources.notes: ADS-focused scenario framework used as a structural reference; it does not make the Level-0 KINGMAST function compliant.

sources.title: ISO 34503:2023 Road vehicles — Test scenarios for automated driving systems — Specification for operational design domain
sources.notes: Used as a reference for hierarchical operating-condition/ODD description.

sources.title: ISO 34504:2024 Road vehicles — Test scenarios for automated driving systems — Scenario categorization
sources.notes: Used to structure scenario tags and environmental/dynamic-entity categorization.

sources.title: ISO 34505:2025 Road vehicles — Test scenarios for automated driving systems — Scenario evaluation and test case generation
sources.notes: Used for traceable test-case fields such as identifiers, objectives, inputs, platforms and expected results, and for coverage/prioritization concepts.

sources.title: ASAM OpenSCENARIO XML
sources.notes: Current ASAM landing page; as of 2026-09 the listed current version is 1.4.0, released 2026-05-19.

sources.title: ASAM OpenODD Base Standard 1.0.0
sources.notes: Reference for machine-readable operating domain/ODD modelling and future simulator interchange.

sources.title: Euro NCAP Safety Assist — latest protocols
sources.notes: Latest protocol index used only as scenario/test comparator, not as a KINGMAST score or approval claim.

sources.title: AEB Car-to-Car Test Protocol v4.3.1
sources.notes: Used to ensure research coverage includes stationary/moving/braking lead, turn-across-path, crossing-path and head-on conflict families. No AEB claim is made.

sources.title: FMVSS No. 127 Automatic Emergency Braking Systems for Light Vehicles — final rule information
sources.notes: AEB/PAEB regulation used only to identify vehicle/pedestrian scenario gaps. KINGMAST remains warning-only and does not claim FMVSS 127 compliance.
